opening.argument: The speaker directly urges team members to buy multiple paid positions in a binary downline structure, telling them to purchase two more and not to be cheap or stingy. He presents those positions as valuable future real estate that can be resold as Clubcoin rises, while asserting his belief that the coin will skyrocket. That combination matters: a recruitment-dependent structure is paired with an appreciation-based earning pitch to encourage purchases and participation. The speaker promotes the offer rather than reporting on it or critically examining it, establishing the scam character of the recruitment pitch.

don't be cheap, don't be stingy, get yourself some positions
